name: nowlisten
description: Search and read text transcripts you explicitly synced from your NowListen account, or open a temporary shared transcript.

interface.longDescription: Sign into your NowListen account to search, list and read transcripts you explicitly synced. Text includes titles, dates, timestamps and speaker labels; audio stays on your device. Local-only recordings are not accessible. You can revoke account access by disabling sync in NowListen. Temporary shared links remain readable for 24 hours without login; anyone with a link can open that selected transcript.
